correctness.rationale: Deleting a conditioned leaf gives a uniform (n-1)-vertex Cayley tree and uniform attachment. Splitting the marked leaf into root versus nonroot cases yields the stated exact covariance p_n[2n-1+(n-3)b_{n-1}-n b_n]. Path-counting produces w_n and b_n; integral remainder and Laplace expansion w_n=-3/(4n)-11/(16n^2)+O(n^{-3}) imply b_n=n/2+1/8+1/(32n)+O(n^{-2}), hence covariance 1/(8e)+O(1/n). Conditional bipartite Prüfer occupancy is correctly distinguished from novelty. Independent full Cayley enumeration at n=3..6 reproduces exact covariance 0,3/32,144/3125,665/11664.
